SELECT f.nicklabel AS nickname,
       m.spendusd * (1 + (m.membdays / 365.0) * 0.5) * (1 + (i.gifttot / 10.0) * 0.2) AS monetization_value,
       e.engrate AS engagement_rate,
       json_extract(i.engagement_metrics, '$.chat_activity.chatmsg') * 1.0 / p.sesscount AS chat_to_session_ratio,
       m.membkind AS membership_tier,
       m.spendusd / json_extract(i.engagement_metrics, '$.session.watchhrs') AS revenue_per_watch_hour,
       CASE e.contpref
            WHEN 'Music'  THEN 'Content Consumer (Music)'
            WHEN 'Dance'  THEN 'Content Consumer (Dance)'
            WHEN 'Gaming' THEN 'Content Consumer (Gaming)'
            ELSE 'General Content Consumer'
       END AS content_preference_classification
FROM fans f
LEFT JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
LEFT JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
LEFT JOIN interactions i ON i.activityreg = e.engageactivitypivot
LEFT JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.preferencesmemberpivot = m.memberreg
WHERE m.spendusd * (1 + (m.membdays / 365.0) * 0.5) * (1 + (i.gifttot / 10.0) * 0.2) > 100
  AND e.engrate < 0.3
  AND json_extract(i.engagement_metrics, '$.chat_activity.chatmsg') * 1.0 / p.sesscount < 0.5
ORDER BY monetization_value DESC

SELECT f.userregistry AS user_id,
       f.nicklabel AS nickname,
       json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.contqualrate') AS content_quality,
       json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.ugcval') AS content_volume,
       json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.network.follcount') AS follower_count,
       CASE WHEN json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.contqualrate') > 8.5
                 AND json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.network.follcount') > 1000
                 AND json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.ugcval') > 20
                 THEN 'High-Value Content Creator'
            WHEN json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.contqualrate') > 7.0
                 AND json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.ugcval') > 20
                 THEN 'Content Creator'
            ELSE 'Regular Fan'
       END AS content_creator_classification
FROM fans f
JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
JOIN socialcommunity s ON s.socialengagepivot = e.engagereg
ORDER BY content_quality DESC, follower_count DESC

SELECT f.userregistry AS user_id,
       f.nicklabel AS nickname,
       ROUND((i.giftvalusd * i.gifttot) / 100.0, 2) AS gift_impact_quotient,
       m.membkind AS membership_type
FROM fans f
JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
JOIN interactions i ON i.activityreg = e.engageactivitypivot
WHERE m.membkind IN ('Free', 'Basic')
  AND (i.giftvalusd * i.gifttot) / 100.0 > 50
  AND m.spendusd < 100
ORDER BY gift_impact_quotient DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN f.tierstep IS NULL OR f.tierstep < 1 THEN 'Undefined'
            WHEN f.tierstep BETWEEN 1 AND 3  THEN 'Entry-level'
            WHEN f.tierstep BETWEEN 4 AND 7  THEN 'Mid-level'
            WHEN f.tierstep BETWEEN 8 AND 10 THEN 'High-level'
            ELSE 'Core'
       END AS tier_category,
       COUNT(*) AS fan_count,
       ROUND(AVG(f.ptsval), 2) AS avg_points,
       ROUND(AVG(m.spendusd), 2) AS avg_spending
FROM fans f
LEFT JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
WHERE f.statustag IN ('Active', 'VIP')
GROUP BY tier_category

SELECT f.userregistry AS user_id,
       f.nicklabel AS nickname,
       COALESCE(m.spendusd, 0) + COALESCE(i.giftvalusd, 0) AS total_support_usd
FROM fans f
LEFT JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
LEFT JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
LEFT JOIN interactions i ON i.activityreg = e.engageactivitypivot
WHERE COALESCE(i.giftvalusd, 0) > 500 OR COALESCE(m.spendusd, 0) > 1000
ORDER BY total_support_usd DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.userregistry AS fan_id,
         f.nicklabel AS nickname,
         (m.spendusd * (1 + (m.membdays / 365.0) * 0.5) * (1 + (i.gifttot / 10.0) * 0.2))
         * (1 - ((1 - p.intconsist) * 2
                 + ((julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(p.lastlogdt)) / 30.0) * 0.5
                 + ((CASE r.churnflag WHEN 'None' THEN 0 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 END) / 3.0) * 2
                ) / 10.0)
         * (1 + (e.engrate * 0.4 + (e.socintscore / 100.0) * 0.3 + (e.actdayswk / 7.0) * 0.2 + (e.avgsesscount / 10.0) * 0.1))
         * 24 AS flv
  FROM fans f
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
  JOIN interactions i ON i.activityreg = e.engageactivitypivot
  JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.preferencesmemberpivot = m.memberreg
  JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT fan_id, nickname, flv, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY flv) AS pr FROM base
)
SELECT fan_id,
       nickname,
       ROUND(flv, 2) AS fan_lifetime_value,
       CASE WHEN pr > 0.90 THEN 'Top Tier'
            WHEN pr > 0.75 THEN 'High Value'
            WHEN pr > 0.50 THEN 'Medium Value'
            ELSE 'Low Value'
       END AS fan_value_segment
FROM ranked
ORDER BY fan_lifetime_value DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.nicklabel AS nickname,
         json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.group_involvement.grprole') AS group_role,
         e.actfreq AS activity_frequency,
         m.membdays AS membership_days,
         ((json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.contqualrate')
           * (json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.ugcval') / 10.0)
           * (1 + (json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.network.follcount') / 100.0) * 0.5)) * 0.4)
         + (((json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.network.follcount') / 100.0) * (e.engrate * 2) * (r.viralcont + 1) * 0.5) * 0.3)
         + (s.collabcount * 0.1)
         + ((e.engrate * 0.4 + (e.socintscore / 100.0) * 0.3 + (e.actdayswk / 7.0) * 0.2 + (e.avgsesscount / 10.0) * 0.1) * 0.2) AS cci
  FROM fans f
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
  JOIN socialcommunity s ON s.socialengagepivot = e.engagereg
  JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg
)
SELECT nickname,
       ROUND(cci, 2) AS community_contribution_index,
       group_role,
       activity_frequency,
       membership_days
FROM base
WHERE cci > 7
  AND activity_frequency = 'Daily'
  AND membership_days > 180
  AND group_role IN ('Moderator', 'Leader')
ORDER BY community_contribution_index DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.nicklabel AS nickname,
         f.tierstep AS tier_level,
         e.engrate * 0.4 + (e.socintscore / 100.0) * 0.3 + (e.actdayswk / 7.0) * 0.2 + (e.avgsesscount / 10.0) * 0.1 AS fei,
         m.spendusd * (1 + (m.membdays / 365.0) * 0.5) * (1 + (i.gifttot / 10.0) * 0.2) AS mv
  FROM fans f
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
  JOIN interactions i ON i.activityreg = e.engageactivitypivot
  WHERE f.statustag IN ('Active', 'VIP')
)
SELECT nickname,
       tier_level,
       ROUND(fei, 2) AS fan_engagement_index,
       ROUND(mv, 2) AS monetization_value,
       CASE WHEN tier_level >= 8 AND fei > 0.7 AND mv > 200 THEN 'Superfan' ELSE 'Regular Fan' END AS fan_status
FROM base
ORDER BY fan_engagement_index DESC, monetization_value DESC

SELECT r.churnflag AS churn_risk_level,
       COUNT(*) AS fan_count,
       ROUND(AVG(julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(p.lastlogdt)), 2) AS avg_days_since_last_login,
       ROUND(AVG(e.engrate), 2) AS avg_engagement_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(p.intconsist), 2) AS avg_interaction_consistency,
       ROUND(AVG((1 - p.intconsist) * 2
                 + ((julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(p.lastlogdt)) / 30.0) * 0.5
                 + ((CASE r.churnflag WHEN 'None' THEN 0 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 END) / 3.0) * 2), 2) AS avg_retention_risk_factor
FROM retentionandinfluence r
JOIN engagement e ON e.engagereg = r.retainengagepivot
JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.preferencesmemberpivot = m.memberreg
GROUP BY r.churnflag

SELECT f.userregistry AS user_id,
       f.nicklabel AS nickname,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS idol_count,
       group_concat(DISTINCT v.nametag) AS idol_names,
       ROUND(AVG(e.engrate), 2) AS avg_engagement_rate
FROM fans f
JOIN interactions i ON i.interactfanpivot = f.userregistry
JOIN virtualidols v ON v.entityreg = i.interactidolpivot
JOIN engagement e ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
GROUP BY f.userregistry, f.nicklabel
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) >= 2
   AND MIN(e.engrate) > 0.4
ORDER BY idol_count DESC, avg_engagement_rate DESC
